name: Puna

associations.name: Ichu bunchgrass puna

associations.name: Polylepis (quenua) woodland
associations.where: sheltered rocky slopes, boulder fields and gullies at 3800-4800 m
associations.source: Kessler 1995 Polylepis-Walder Boliviens; Fjeldsa & Kessler 1996 Conserving the biological diversity of Polylepis woodlands

associations.name: Tola shrub steppe
associations.where: dry gravelly plains and gentle slopes of the southern puna and altiplano
associations.source: Cabrera 1968; Navarro & Maldonado 2002 Geografia ecologica de Bolivia

associations.name: Bofedal cushion bog
associations.where: valley floors, spring seeps and glacier-fed flats with year-round saturated soil
associations.source: Squeo et al. 2006 Bofedales: high altitude peatlands of the central Andes (Rev. Chil. Hist. Nat.); Ruthsatz 2012

associations.name: Puya raimondii rocky slope
